paper_metadata.title: SOLAR 10.7B: Scaling Large Language Models with Simple yet Effective Depth Up-Scaling
paper_metadata.abstract: We introduce SOLAR 10.7B, a large language model (LLM) with 10.7 billion parameters, demonstrating superior performance in various natural language processing (NLP) tasks. Inspired by recent efforts to efficiently up-scale LLMs, we present a method for scaling LLMs called depth up-scaling (DUS), which encompasses depthwise scaling and continued pretraining. In contrast to other LLM up-scaling methods that use mixture-of-experts, DUS does not require complex changes to train and inference efficiently. We show experimentally that DUS is simple yet effective in scaling up high-performance LLMs from small ones. Building on the DUS model, we additionally present SOLAR 10.7B-Instruct, a variant fine-tuned for instruction-following capabilities, surpassing Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct. SOLAR 10.7B is publicly available under the Apache 2.0 license, promoting broad access and application in the LLM field.

extraction_data.innovation: Depth Up-Scaling (DUS): increases model depth while keeping width constant to scale parameters, followed by continued pretraining to recover performance, offering a simpler alternative to MoE; Instruction tuning via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to align with human intentions and improve steerability without RLHF complexities.
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning for instruction following, Supervised instruction tuning followed by Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
extraction_data.extension: Depth Up-Scaling (DUS) technique to increase model depth from a base model without adding new modules or requiring specialized training frameworks.
extraction_data.paper_title: SOLAR 10.7B: Scaling Large Language Models with Simple yet Effective Depth Up-Scaling
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Alpaca-GPT4, OpenOrca, Synth.Math-Instruct, OrcaDPOPairs, UltrafeedbackCleaned, Synth.Math-Alignment, FLAN-derived datasets (OpenOrca, ARC, HellaSwag, MMLU, TruthfulQA, Winogrande, GSM8K)
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Depthwise scaling (adding layers) -> Continued pretraining -> Supervised fine-tuning for instruction following
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Rephrasing seed math data from the Math dataset to create Synth.Math-Instruct; rephrasing QA pairs to create Synth.Math-Alignment for sDPO
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Pairwise preference optimization using chosen (rephrased answer) and rejected (original answer) responses
extraction_data.base_model: Llama 2 architecture initialized with pretrained weights from Mistral 7B
